items.text: to dig a way out (doer: the woman)
items.evidence: 0.12-3.88s she shovels snow out of a narrow path between deep snow walls beside the cottage (P1 box on her throughout). Digging is clear; 'out' (an escape/exit from being snowed in) is not shown: the path runs along the cottage wall, no blocked door or exit is visible.
items.fix_hint: to dig a way through the snow / to clear a way through the snow

items.text: to squeeze past the shovel (doer: the dog)
items.evidence: 1.62-2.88s the husky drops into the narrow path and squeezes between the left snow wall and the shovel (handle across in front of it at 2.12-2.38s, blade beside it at 2.62-2.88s); P2 box follows it.

items.text: to cheer inside the cottage (doer: the man)
items.evidence: Behind the window (inside), the man raises a fist and cheers 1.12-2.62s; P3 box is on him throughout.

Zoomed on the nouns still: the dot is on the face of the RIGHT snow wall, just right of the woman's right trouser leg (leg edge ~x 0.50). Not on the cleared path floor. Above y 0.80 the path floor is hidden by the woman, the dog and the shovel; the only floor visible at y<=0.72 is a narrow light strip between her legs, left of the shovel handle (x ~0.36-0.38, y 0.66-0.78).
items.fix_hint: move to (0.37,0.71) - path floor seen between her legs (narrow strip; nearest valid floor point). No wider path-floor area exists at y<=0.72.

items.text: the shovel (0.4,0.7)
items.evidence: Zoomed: the point is on the wooden shovel handle just below her right glove.

items.text: the cottage (0.15,0.25)
items.evidence: Zoomed: the dot is on open blue sky left of the cottage, below the gutter end; no cottage under it.
items.fix_hint: move onto the dark wooden wall, e.g. (0.42,0.22) (wall between the downpipe and the window, above her hat)
